 Rockets guard Marcus Smart ejected for punching Warriors center Charles Bassey 
 Things got physical between Houston Rockets guard Marcus Smart and Golden State Warriors center Charles Bassey in the third quarter on Wednesday. 
 By Angelina Martin • 
 Published 51 minutes ago • 
 Updated 40 minutes ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Share 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 Houston Rockets guard Marcus Smart is ejected in the third quarter for punching Golden State Warriors center Charles Bassey on Wednesday night. 
 The Warriors' game against the Houston Rockets on Wednesday at Toyota Center has been a physical matchup, but things took a violent turn in the third quarter.
 With 21 seconds left in the frame, Rockets point guard Marcus Smart received a Flagrant 2 foul and subsequently was ejected after throwing a punch at Warriors center Charles Bassey. After review, officials concluded Smart did in fact make contract with Bassey's nose.
 Marcus Smart just threw a punch at Charles Bassey pic.twitter.com/OlAX9OogZ1 
— Warriors on NBCS (@NBCSWarriors) November 12, 2026

 Just moments before, Bassey and Smart got tangled up beneath the basket -- something Smart oddly took issue with, made evident by the fact that he sprinted over to Bassey afterward to swing on him.
 Bassey kept his composure during the altercation and didn't retaliate, and the big man went on to make 1 of 2 free throws awarded to him after the Flagrant 2 foul.
 This all came after Warriors star Steph Curry was ruled out when he was injured in the second quarter, seemingly as a result of several hard hits from Houston.
